init_distributed: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with auto-detected MPI rank, size, and backend
alltoall: perform an all-to-all communication across ranks using scatter/gather or native all_to_all_single
all_gather: gather tensors from all ranks into a single tensor along a specified dimension
barrier: synchronize all distributed ranks with a barrier when running in multi-process mode
get_split_lengths: compute the local and global split lengths for evenly distributing data across ranks
